summary: Omnigent is a Python "meta-harness" (Click CLI, entrypoint omnigent.cli:main, installed as `omnigent`/`omni`) that orchestrates coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Pi behind a local server + runner. A one-shot non-interactive task is `omnigent run <agent-dir> -p "<task>"`: the CLI spawns a background host daemon and local server on 127.0.0.1, the daemon spawns a runner in the CLI's cwd, the runner launches the harness, and the CLI prints the final assistant text and exits. The recipe uses the built-in `claude-sdk` harness, which drives the Claude Code CLI bundled inside the claude-agent-sdk wheel (no Node required) and therefore speaks the Anthropic messages API; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY are on Omnigent's CLI->daemon->runner env allowlists, so the CLI posts to $PROXY_URL/v1/messages. The run command materializes a small bundle config.yaml (bundle format so `permission_mode: bypassPermissions` is honored) with `executor.auth: {type: api_key}` (the executor strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and feeds the key through an apiKeyHelper) and `os_env.sandbox.type: none` (no bwrap needed); file/shell edits happen through Omnigent's sys_os_* MCP tools, loaded on demand via the CLI's ToolSearch. Verified end to end in Docker against a mock Anthropic server: ToolSearch -> sys_os_write wrote a file into the task cwd, final text printed, exit 0, logs copied to /out.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=python:3.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

# Self-contained harness runtime under /opt/harness; never touches the base image's python/node.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git bash procps \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

ENV UV_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/bin \
    UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/python \
    UV_PYTHON_PREFERENCE=only-managed \
    UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/opt/harness/venv \
    UV_CACHE_DIR=/opt/harness/uv-cache \
    UV_LINK_MODE=copy \
    OMNIGENT_SKIP_WEB_UI=true

RUN curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env INSTALLER_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh \
    && /opt/harness/bin/uv python install 3.12

# Repo root is the build context; install omnigent (plus its sdks/ path deps) from the locked resolution.
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN cd /opt/harness/src \
    && /opt/harness/bin/uv sync --frozen --no-dev --python 3.12 \
    && rm -rf /opt/harness/uv-cache \
    && ln -sf /opt/harness/venv/bin/omnigent /opt/harness/bin/omnigent \
    && ln -sf /opt/harness/venv/bin/omni /opt/harness/bin/omni

# Only /opt/harness/bin (omnigent, omni, uv) goes on PATH: the venv's own python must NOT shadow the base image's.
# Debian/Ubuntu /etc/profile resets PATH for login shells (bash -lc); re-add the harness bin dir there too.
RUN printf 'export PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH\n' > /etc/profile.d/zz-omnigent-harness.sh
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH
run_command:
set -uo pipefail
mkdir -p /out "$OMNIGENT_DATA_DIR" "$OMNIGENT_CONFIG_HOME" "$HOME/.claude"
# Claude Code opt-outs go in its settings file: plain env vars are stripped on the CLI->daemon->runner hops.
[ -f "$HOME/.claude/settings.json" ] || printf '{"env":{"DISABLE_TELEMETRY":"1","DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER":"1","DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING":"1","CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC":"1"}}\n' > "$HOME/.claude/settings.json"
AGENT_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omnigent-agent.XXXXXX)
cat > "$AGENT_DIR/config.yaml" <<EOF
spec_version: 1
name: bench_agent
executor:
  type: omnigent
  model: ${OMNIGENT_MODEL}
  auth:
    type: api_key
    api_key: ${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}
  config:
    harness: claude-sdk
    permission_mode: bypassPermissions
prompt: |
  You are a software engineering agent running non-interactively inside a sandbox.
  Work in the current working directory. Do not ask questions; complete the task
  fully, then briefly summarize what you changed.
os_env:
  type: caller_process
  sandbox:
    type: none
EOF
omnigent run "$AGENT_DIR" -p "$TASK" --debug-events 2>&1 | tee /out/omnigent-run.log
status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
cp -r "$OMNIGENT_DATA_DIR"/logs "$OMNIGENT_DATA_DIR"/debug /out/ 2>/dev/null || true
exit $status
notes: Verified locally (Docker, arm64): overlay builds on python:3.12-slim-bookworm and on a replica of the benchmark image (buildpack-deps:jammy + deadsnakes python3.11); check_command passes on both and `python3` on the task image still resolves to the base's 3.11 (only /opt/harness/bin is on PATH; the venv dir is deliberately not). End-to-end smoke run against a mock Anthropic messages server: daemon/server/runner/Claude CLI came up in ~60s, requests hit $PROXY_URL/v1/messages?beta=true (query string present; proxy must tolerate it), permissionMode=bypassPermissions, apiKeySource=apiKeyHelper, cwd=/work; ToolSearch -> mcp__omnigent__sys_os_write wrote hello.txt into the task cwd; final text printed; exit 0. Design notes: (1) claude-sdk was chosen over openai-agents because the openai-agents executor defaults to the OpenAI /responses endpoint which the proxy does not serve. (2) The bundled Claude CLI (claude-agent-sdk 0.2.94 platform wheels, ~70MB, no Node) is used because no system `claude` exists; on that path Omnigent disables the CLI's native Bash/Read/Write tools by design and routes file/shell work through its own sys_os_read/write/edit/shell MCP tools, which the CLI loads on demand through ToolSearch (so the first request carries only Skill+ToolSearch tools). (3) executor.auth must carry the key because the executor strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the CLI's env and injects it via apiKeyHelper; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is inherited through Omnigent's env allowlists (no `base_url` in auth, which would enable the gateway shim/model-listing path). (4) IS_SANDBOX=1 is on Omnigent's runner env allowlist and is required for Claude Code to accept bypassPermissions as root. (5) `--log` is rejected together with `-p`, so trajectory artifacts are: stdout tee'd to /out/omnigent-run.log plus $OMNIGENT_DATA_DIR/logs/{cli,host,server,runner} (and debug/ when produced) copied to /out; the runner log contains the CLI init/system messages. (6) The CLI also issues small side calls (e.g. haiku title generation) through the same proxy; the proxy's model substitution covers them. (7) The web UI build is skipped at install (OMNIGENT_SKIP_WEB_UI=true) so no Node/pnpm is needed; the server serves an API-only landing page. (8) A persistent host daemon + local server on 127.0.0.1:6767 remain running after the one-shot; they die with the container. (9) The `omnigent-client`/`omnigent-ui-sdk` path deps under sdks/ are installed editable from /opt/harness/src via uv.lock (--frozen), which is why the whole repo is COPYed.
